blocks.text: Why Excel remains the top tool for digital media planners

You likely live in Excel to track pacing, manage media spend, and build client-facing reports. While many platforms exist, Excel is the only place where you can combine data from multiple sources into one view. It is flexible, powerful, and installed on every Mac in your office.
Essential Excel shortcuts for Mac users
Speed matters when you are updating a budget sheet before a client meeting. Stop using your mouse for everything. Use these shortcuts to move faster.

Media plans can grow massive. Excel handles up to 1,048,576 rows and 16,384 columns. If your sheet gets slow, check for circular references or unnecessary conditional formatting. Use named ranges to make your formulas readable. Instead of writing =SUM(A2:A500), you can define A2:A500 as 'TotalSpend' and write =SUM(TotalSpend).

blocks.text: How to use Lazur to work faster

Lazur is a voice assistant for your Mac. When you are stuck in a complex Excel sheet, hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a feature. You can ask 'How do I freeze the top row?' and Lazur will point at the View menu. It does not click for you, but it saves you the time of hunting through menus.

faq.question: Can I use Excel on Mac exactly like on Windows?
faq.answer: Most features are identical, but some keyboard shortcuts differ. You may need to customize your Mac system shortcuts if they conflict with Excel.

faq.question: Is Lazur an Excel plugin?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is a system-wide voice assistant for macOS. It works in any app, including Excel, without needing any plugins.

demo.spoken: Lazur, how do I create a pivot table in this sheet?
demo.result: Lazur highlights the Insert tab and the PivotTable button, explaining the steps to select your data range.

tasks.say: Lazur, how do I freeze the top row?
tasks.result: Lazur points to View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row.

tasks.say: Lazur, what is the shortcut for selecting a column?
tasks.result: Lazur tells you to press Ctrl + Space.

tasks.say: Lazur, help me write an XLOOKUP formula for this budget sheet.
tasks.result: Lazur explains the syntax: =XLOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_array, return_array).

tasks.say: Lazur, where is the conditional formatting menu?
tasks.result: Lazur circles the Home tab and the Conditional Formatting button.

tasks.say: Lazur, dictate these campaign notes into my report.
tasks.result: Lazur listens to your notes and types them into the active cell.
